display.title: Episode 350: The Return of Little Tzip Tzip (Rosh Chodesh Kislev)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Rosh Chodesh Kislev, Uncle Yossi teaches that friendship among Jews brings Moshiach, an eight-year-old recites a Mishnah on lost objects, and a little bird learns where a bad smell really comes from.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the day before Rosh Chodesh Kislev 5749, the month of miracles. Uncle Yossi explains the prayer said on Shabbos Mevarchim: Hashem who did miracles for our fathers should redeem us soon, and the secret is in the next words, 'all of Israel are friends'. Ahavas Yisroel, the opposite of baseless hatred, is the key that ends the golus and brings Moshiach, who will carry us on clouds to Eretz Yisroel and the third Beis HaMikdash. After the Hakochainik march, an eight-year-old yeshiva boy recites the Shema and the Mishnah in Bava Metzia about which found objects may be kept, a lesson in returning lost things. Following the sponsor comes the story of Tzip Tzip, a little bird who flies east, west, north and south and returns home each time complaining of a terrible smell, until her mother finds a speck of dirt on the tip of her nose. Uncle Yossi draws the lesson: look at others with a good eye, see the faults we notice in others as a mirror of our own, and correct ourselves first. The show ends with Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: Look at others with a good eye; the faults we see in others are often our own, so correct yourself first, and love every Jew.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: 'tomorrow night is Rosh Chodesh Kislev' (1 Kislev 5749 = Thursday 10 Nov 1988) and 'this past Shabbos, Shabbos Mevarchim'.
